Chapter 568: Chapter 15: The Hope of the Longshan Family (Please Subscribe)

“`

“Patriarch…”

The elder, named Longshan Zhu, had already been a Fourth Level Knight many years ago and was part of the Longshan Family’s foundation.

How many Fourth Level Knights were there throughout the entire Longshan Ling?

If Baron Longshan hadn’t personally sent a message this time,

it would have been impossible for Longshan Zhu, with his status, to make an exception for a junior member of the Longshan Family.

...

Yet, Longshan Zhu could never have imagined that the task he had planned to deal with in a perfunctory manner would turn out to be such a fantastical, unbelievable affair.

So much so that even now, he was still somewhat dazed, constantly needing to confirm whether or not he was dreaming.

“What’s the matter?”

When Baron Longshan saw that Longshan Zhu wasn’t speaking, he faintly sensed that something was wrong, “Could it be that Ayuan is really a piece of rotten wood?”

Baron Longshan’s tone was somewhat disappointed. The Longshan Family’s bloodline was extraordinary, and they cultivated the hereditary Longshan Cultivation Skill.

Plus, with Longshan Zhu, a predecessor like him providing guidance, even if Longshan Yuan was below average, sensing the Qi Sea within a month shouldn’t be difficult.

“Rotten wood?”

Longshan Zhu was taken aback upon hearing Baron Longshan say this and hurriedly explained, “Patriarch, Young Master Yuan is not a piece of rotten wood, he… he has already sensed the Qi Sea…”

“Not a piece of rotten wood…”

Baron Longshan had just heaved a sigh of relief when he suddenly widened his eyes, “What did you say, he has already sensed the Qi Sea?”

Whether it was the Longshan Cultivation Skill or any other Knight’s cultivation method, the first step is to sense the Qi Sea.

That is also the prerequisite for becoming a First Level Knight, and any creature that senses the Qi Sea can transform itself by harnessing the power of the Qi Sea, and immediately afterwards, can choose to cultivate a Knight’s method that suits them.

But sensing the Qi Sea… is difficult, and it is also a great test of a Knight’s talent.

The Longshan Family allocates one month for its members to sense the Qi Sea.

As long as they sense the Qi Sea within this month, they will have the hope of becoming formal Knights and will be nurtured by the Longshan Family.

But now?

How long had it been since Longshan Zhu began guiding Longshan Yuan?

An hour?

Or two hours?

“You’re saying Ayuan sensed the Qi Sea within two hours?” Baron Longshan’s voice trembled slightly.

In the history of the Longshan Family, since The First Viscount took over Longshan Ling, only three people had sensed the Qi Sea within two hours.

Two of these three people eventually became Fifth Level Grand Knights and left a significant mark on the history of the Longshan Family.

The remaining one unfortunately perished along the way.

Not every generation of the Longshan Family has a Fifth Level Grand Knight in command; for example, the current strongest person in Longshan Ling is only at the Fourth Level.

The birth of a Fifth Level Grand Knight means that the Longshan Family’s power would return to its peak, to the era of The First Viscount, and the surrounding Viscounts would become utterly submissive and cooperative.

The Empire would even bestow rewards once again, congratulating the Longshan Family for the birth of another Grand Knight.

Such numerous honors… and benefits all because of a Fifth Level Grand Knight.

“Sensed the Qi Sea within two hours…” Longshan Zhu fell silent again.

If it were truly so, he would be overwhelmed with joy at this moment, instead of appearing as he did now, uncertain of how to speak, and with a tinge of… trepidation.

“Patriarch, the time Young Master Yuan took to sense the Qi Sea… was two breaths…” Longshan Zhu steadied himself and spoke with some difficulty.

Actually, whether it was even two breaths, Longshan Zhu wasn’t certain—he only remembered Longshan Yuan glancing at the Longshan Cultivation Skill and then claiming to have sensed the Qi Sea.

If it were not for Longshan Zhu’s true sense of the Qi Sea fluctuations within Longshan Yuan’s body, he might have even planned to scold the latter a few words.

“What did you say… two breaths?” Baron Longshan was dumbstruck.

If it were within two hours to sense the Qi Sea, he could still barely understand, but in two breaths?

Two breaths hardly gave enough time even to calm one’s mind, let alone sense the Qi Sea, right?

“Are you sure?”

Baron Longshan took a deep breath and stood up, asking solemnly.

Although he knew Longshan Zhu well and understood that this elder of the Longshan Family never liked to joke around, especially concerning matters of great importance to the family, he would never engage in any deceit or concealment.

But sensing the Qi Sea within two breaths was too incredible.

“I am certain.”

Longshan Zhu stated with utmost conviction.

He was certain that Longshan Yuan’s Qi Sea had been sensed only after he had met him and looked at that Longshan Cultivation Skill.

“Sensing the Qi Sea within two breaths… Does it mean that my Longshan Family is truly going to soar to the heavens…” After his shock, Baron Longshan was ecstatic.

If sensing the Qi Sea within two hours already holds the hope of becoming a Fifth Level Grand Knight,

then what about sensing the Qi Sea within two breaths? A Sixth Level Legendary Knight? Or a Seventh Level Demigod?

You should know that on the Plateau of Myriad Nations, as long as a Seventh Level Demigod doesn’t secretly spread their faith, just casually joining any of those empires brings infinite glory upon them, even the gods residing in the Ocean of Light cast admiring glances their way.

A Seventh Level Demigod, if willing, can strike a deal with the gods of the Ocean of Light and can absolutely start a new empire.

“Who else knows about this?”

Baron Longshan’s gaze suddenly became deep.

“Patriarch, only the two of us are aware of it,”

Longshan Zhu also understood the gravity of the situation and spoke earnestly.

“That’s good.”

Baron Longshan nodded.

The surrounding Viscount’s territories, even those further away, allow the Longshan Family to bring forth a future Grand Knight candidate who sensed the Qi Sea within two hours.

But to have sensed the Qi Sea within two breaths? Should this news leak, it would not be a good thing.
